boards.hardware: ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM; GC9D01 160x160 round TFT; ES8311 + ES7210 audio; BQ27220 fuel gauge; vibration motor
boards.identify: Round screen, about 100 px of it visible through the case; three buttons: BOOT, VOL+, VOL-
boards.flash_port: USB-C (the chip's own USB). Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.
boards.use: Muse voice assistant: hold BOOT to talk; answers are spoken when the build has a MiniMax key
boards.notes: Production board. Once the screen starts the log continues on USB only (GPIO43, UART0 TX, is the display reset).

boards.hardware: Same parts as WWY-01 on an earlier PCB: different display pins, display powered from GPIO46, no 32 kHz crystal
boards.identify: Looks like WWY-01. Its screen stays dark for about a second at boot. If unsure, flash WWY-01 first; if the screen stays dark, flash this one.
boards.flash_port: USB-C. Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.
boards.use: Muse voice assistant, same as WWY-01
boards.notes: Early hardware revision. The volume keys are swapped compared to WWY-01.
